bargains.title: Gold in the Ashes
bargains.text: The hearth speaks in your father's voice. There is gold under the old wing, it says, if someone will dream of where.
bargains.promise: Beneath the old wing, a strongbox no one remembers burying.

bargains.title: The Smith's Dream
bargains.text: Your armorer wakes with burned palms and a shape in his head he cannot stop drawing. He could forge it, if he is paid in years.
bargains.promise: The thing he forges in a single night is finer than anything in the kingdom.

bargains.title: A Name in the Ledger
bargains.text: A ledger lies open on your desk, in a hand you do not know. Write a rival House's name in it, and their luck will change.
bargains.misfortune: A beam gives way in the night; part of the house will need rebuilding.
bargains.promise: The ink dries, and the ledger closes by itself.

bargains.title: The Crying Cradle
bargains.text: Something cries in the nursery, though there is no child there. Hush it with one of your recruits, it suggests, and it will go next door.
bargains.misfortune: Two of the household's hopefuls are gone by morning, their beds cold.
bargains.promise: The crying stops. Somewhere down the street, it begins again.

bargains.title: A Gift for a Rival
bargains.text: A stranger leaves a beautiful casket at your gate, addressed to no one. Send it on, he says, to whoever you like least.
bargains.misfortune: A casket turns up among the stores; whatever is inside will not let go of whoever lifts it.
bargains.promise: The casket is carried away, and the stranger smiles.

bargains.title: The Whispering Well
bargains.text: Your well has begun to answer questions. It wants only a little of your Scions' sleep in return.
bargains.promise: The well tells you things about the rift that no book holds.

bargains.title: The Mirror of Blood
bargains.text: Your strongest Scion sees another face in the mirror: their own, but stronger. It would trade places, a little, for a little blood.
bargains.promise: They are stronger in the morning, and will not look at the mirror again.

bargains.title: Stones That Move
bargains.text: Masons from nowhere offer to raise a wall by morning. They want to be paid in timber, and in a word you will not remember saying.
bargains.promise: By morning one of your halls stands taller, its new stones still warm.

bargains.title: The Long Fever
bargains.text: A plague-doctor with no face asks which House deserves the fever he carries. Not yours, he promises, if you answer.
bargains.misfortune: A sweating fever goes through the household; the Scions sleep badly for weeks.
bargains.promise: He bows, and walks off toward the house you named.

bargains.title: The Crown's Favor
bargains.text: The Cursed King kneels, but the crown is still talking. It offers you the old court's treasury, for one oath sworn in the dark.
bargains.promise: The old court's tithe-chests are found under the drowned palace, sealed with your arms.

bargains.title: The Crown's Grudge
bargains.text: The crown remembers every House that bent its knee to the old King. Name one, it says, and it will remind them.
bargains.misfortune: Old foundations crack all at once; the house groans like something remembering.
